honor.title: Honor AI Space login
honor.description: Same credentials as Honor ID / AI Space. Device ID is thing_name from plugin_account. After login, Honor session cookies are stored so the Grit JWT can refresh automatically without a phone.

honor_captcha.title: Captcha
honor_captcha.description: Open this URL while logged into Home Assistant, solve the Honor captcha, then press Submit: {captcha_url}

honor_sms.title: SMS code
honor_sms.description: Enter the SMS code sent to your phone.

login.title: YuGong / Grit account
login.description: RobotCleaner cloud password account (phone without country code). Prefer «Honor AI Space» if you only sign in via Honor ID.

token.title: Cloud token
token.description: Paste JWT or full plugin_account.xml token string. Token-only mode does not auto-refresh — prefer Honor AI Space login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach cloud / Honor ID
error.invalid_auth: Login rejected (bad credentials, captcha, or expired session).
error.captcha_required: Solve the captcha in the browser link first, then continue
error.no_devices: No robots found on this account

abort.no_devices: No robots found on this account

refresh.title: Token / refresh
refresh.description: Honor AI Space mode refreshes the Grit JWT automatically via the stored Honor session. Paste a new token only if needed, or leave blank and Submit to force a silent refresh.

error.invalid_auth: Cloud rejected login (bad credentials or expired/revoked token).
